text: In tense situations, it happens that trembling appears in the body. Usually we suppress it as a sign of cowardice. Meanwhile, how useful this trembling is for releasing tension that otherwise accumulates. Try trembling consciously - stand up, slightly bend your knees, and for 30–60 seconds gently shake your hands, shoulders, hips, buttocks - as if shaking off what is extra. Then take 5 slow deep inhales and exhales. This simple bodily “discharge” gives an unexpected effect: thoughts calm down, the body comes alive, and a sense of safety and self-confidence appears.
